response.overview: Ι  A Ratatouille-like cook cooks in the kitchen of an abandoned neoclassical building with whatever he can find: plaster, chunks of Styrofoam, rancid oils. Two ballerinas dance ballet in this ruined kitchen, on sinks, braziers, rickety tables, in the smoke. They all love Schubert.  ΙΙ  A mistress tends to and tortures her dog in the living room. Two maids assist her in carrying out her will. The dog receives rewards and punishments with the same overflowing joy. Those who know recognize this living room as Trikoupi’s beach. They all love Schubert and Fassbinder.
response.title: Schubert, Cooking, Ballet and Dogs
